paper_title: Searching for dark matter with an unequal delay interferometer
notes: Paper presents constraints on scalar field couplings to fine-structure constant (d_e) and electron mass (d_me) through oscillations of cavity frequency and fiber refractive index. The experiment uses an unequal-delay Mach-Zehnder interferometer with a 52-56 km fiber delay line. Data points extracted from Figure 3 (top panel, galactic DM model). The mass range [4.1×10^-11, 8.3×10^-10] eV corresponds to frequency range [10, 200] kHz via m[eV] = 4.136e-15 * f[Hz]. Coupling values are approximate readings from the exclusion plot. The experiment assumes standard galactic DM density of 0.4 GeV/cm³. Sensitivity is significantly enhanced at mechanical resonance frequencies of the cavity (27.6 kHz and odd multiples). Paper also presents results for relaxion halo model with much stronger constraints. Systematic effects at specific frequencies are excluded from analysis (Table I). Confidence level is 95% as stated in the paper. | selector: text (sole candidate)
